hero.title: Six agents, one job each
hero.lede: A small crew with clear jobs is easier to check than one model that tries to do everything.

image.alt: A long row of switchboard operators working side by side.

houseRules.title: House rules, in your words
lede: Each agent has a list of rules you write yourself. Fernway added "Wrong size or colour: offer a free exchange before a refund" for Orders, and "Reply in the customer's language" for Front desk.

image.alt: The agent crew and how a conversation moves between them.

reviewer.line: The Reviewer read all **21** replies before they went out
reviewer.after: It compares each reply with the sources the agent used. On the test day it had no reason to stop any of them.
